english.title: Aid abet the operation of a public service vehicle without an operators licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), aided, abetted, counselled and procured **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), the operator of a public service vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to use the vehicle on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), for carrying passengers for hire or reward other than under a P.S.V Operator's Licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(5) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981 and section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980.
